purpose: Seed patterns for human-made infographic variation in MDPR visual diversification mode.

flow.description: Used for primary reading order, connecting arrows, and stable pipeline motion.

accent.description: Used for local section identity and normal emphasis.

contrast.description: Used only when an object must read as a point, warning, proof, or editorial interruption.

support.description: Warm or cool surface colors used to avoid one-hue diagrams while preserving coherence.

coherenceRules: uses contrast color only once per local group
label and proof text align to the same left start
seal center aligns to the text group midpoint
minimum text size remains readable in PPT export
uses warm support color instead of a new hue
does not compete with primary flow arrows
same-role nodes share fill and stroke
rail color follows flow role unless a branch has a different meaning
captions align on the reading axis
chip copy stays under four words
contrast color does not repeat as a section color
padding is at least one body line-height horizontally
number role is larger than its label
mini bar uses accent color, not validation contrast
surface depth matches sibling KPI cards

removeWhen: large decorative container does not encode hierarchy
surface duplicates a visible group panel
